_comment: Source of truth for the Briefs Library page (docs/pdf/index.html). Edit this file when adding, replacing, or describing a PDF; do not hand-edit the cards in index.html. Run `npm run build:briefs-library` (or let the GitHub Actions workflow do it on push) to regenerate the page. File sizes are read from disk at build time and do not need to be tracked here.

groups.title: Leadership Briefs
groups.intro: Short, leadership-ready briefs designed to be emailed, screenshared, or printed for command staff. Each one stands on its own — no prior EDD context required.

items.title: EDD Executive Brief
items.description: A 15-slide leadership briefing that explains what Expert-Driven Development is, why it matters now, and what command staff need to do to enable it. Built for a 10-minute Teams readout.
items.audience: Commanders, SgtsMaj, OICs, and senior civilians deciding whether to sponsor an EDD pilot in their section.

items.title: EDD RAI Compliance Brief
items.description: How the EDD SOP maps to DoD Responsible AI guidance and the guardrails published by the Department of War. Use this when legal, IG, or RAI reviewers ask “does this program meet policy?”
items.audience: RAI officers, legal/IG reviewers, and supervisors who need to defend an AI-assisted build to higher headquarters.

items.title: Week 5 — Supervisor Orientation
items.description: Print-ready PDF of the Week 5 supervisor deck. Covers the permission gap, the four evaluation questions, the apprentice problem, and the supervisor quick-reference card.
items.audience: Supervisors, staff NCOs, and section leads attending or running the 30-minute supervisor briefing.

groups.title: Reference Documents
groups.intro: The full SOP and the complete training curricula. These are the authoritative references the rest of the site links back to.

items.title: SOP: Expert-Driven Development (v5, current)
items.description: The current Standard Operating Procedure for AI-assisted tool development. Defines roles, the four phases, the QA gates, and the documentation package every tool must ship with.
items.audience: Builders, supervisors, and reviewers running an EDD project end-to-end.

items.title: Training Curricula (v5, current)
items.description: All six weekly courses in a single printable document: AI fluency, builder orientation, platform training, advanced techniques, supervisor orientation, and the full-stack Week 6 capstone.
items.audience: Instructors planning a cohort and learners who want the whole program in one PDF.

groups.title: Archived Versions
groups.intro: Earlier releases kept for traceability. Use the v5 documents above for current work; reach for these only when you need to compare against a prior revision.

items.title: SOP v3 (superseded)
items.description: Earlier release of the EDD SOP. Superseded by v5 above.
items.audience: Reviewers and auditors comparing the current SOP against an earlier revision for traceability.

items.title: Training Curricula v3 (superseded)
items.description: Earlier release of the EDD Training Curricula. Superseded by v5 above.
items.audience: Instructors and reviewers comparing the current curricula against an earlier revision for traceability.

fallbackGroup.title: Uncategorized PDFs (add to manifest)
fallbackGroup.intro: These PDFs were found in docs/pdf/ but have no entry in docs/pdf/manifest.json. Add a manifest entry (group + description + audience) and rebuild this page so they show up in the right section.
